newsitem.title: USA: Herman Miller splits stock, raises payout.
newsitem.headline: Herman Miller splits stock, raises payout.

text.p: Herman Miller Inc said Monday its board of directors approved a two-for-one stock split and raised the company's quarterly cash dividend rate by 11.5 percent.

Herman Miller said a 100 percent stock dividend will be paid on April 15 to shareholders of record on March 31. The company will pay a cash dividend of $0.725 a share on July7 15 to shareholders of record as of May 31.
The post-split quarterly dividend rate represents an 11.5 percent increase from the current pre-split rate of $0.13 a share.

Herman Miller also reported record net income for the third quarter ended March 1 of $13.5 million, or $0.56 a share, which included a restructuring charge of $5.4 million or $0.23 a sahre. A year earlier, Herman Miller posted third quarter net income of $11.9 million, or $0.47 a share.

"The two-for-one stock split reflects the company's desire to maintain a trading range of $25 to $40 a share. We believe that when the stock is priced in this trading range, it is attractive to both our retail and institutional investors," Herman Miller's chief executive, Michael Volkema, said in a statement.
